$comment: The Playwright image canary.yml's browsers leg runs in, by tag and index digest.
Its tag must name the playwright-core version package.json pins (gotcha 75), so
tools/bump-deps.ts moves it in the same PR and holds playwright-core back until
MCR publishes the matching -noble tag. It lives here rather than in canary.yml
because the App token that pushes bump branches has no workflows permission.
